name: Critter Milton

summary.text: Critter Milton (Chris Milton) is a former financial advisor running as the Unity Party candidate for Colorado's 1st Congressional District.

He is a repeat candidate who previously ran for U.S. Senate (withdrew from the 2020 primary), U.S. House Colorado District 3 (2020), and U.S. House Colorado District 1 (2024, as the Unity Party candidate, receiving 1.2% of the vote).
He earned a degree from the University of Denver in 2006 and studied at the College for Financial Planning; he lives in Alma, Colorado.

experience.text: Worked as a financial advisor for over a decade; has volunteered with Multiple Summits for Multiple Sclerosis.
Founded Backcountry Eagle Productions, an outdoors-focused media company, in 2017; has never held elected office.

sources.title: Colorado U.S. House District 1 candidate Q&A

research_notes: He has not completed Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey, did not return the Denver Post's 2026 candidate Q&A ('Critter Milton did not return the questionnaire'), and his personal website (backcountryeagle.com) is for his outdoors-media company, not a campaign issues page -- no current 2026 policy statement could be found. His 2020 and 2022 Ballotpedia surveys (running for different seats) include some policy content (support for climate action, drug-policy liberalization, term limits), but given the multi-year gap and lack of any 2026 confirmation, I did not use that older material to code positions on the 25 statements; a reviewer could judge whether any of it is still fairly attributable to him today.
